hero.title: Quality starts at the source.
hero.subtitle: Selected fruit and vegetables for the trade. From Mercabarna, we connect good growers with large-volume buyers.

intro.title: Fresh produce wholesale, driven by smart sourcing.
intro.body1: Fruites del Baix Llobregat is a fruit and vegetable wholesaler with stands at Mercabarna, Barcelona's central wholesale food market. We buy from growers and suppliers, mainly in Spain, and sell to professional buyers.
intro.body2: Our work starts long before the produce reaches the market: knowing the growing areas, choosing carefully who we buy from and offering each customer the right product for their business.

featured.title: Produce with a name of its own.
featured.body: Some lines define our seasons. Alongside them, we trade a wide range of fruit and vegetables that changes throughout the year.

origin.title: Knowing how to buy is half the job.
origin.body: The quality of what we sell depends on where and from whom we buy. That is why we take time to get to know our suppliers and to check the produce we receive.

points.title: Sourcing
points.text: We work with trusted growers and suppliers, mostly in Spain, and with local produce from the Baix Llobregat when the season allows.

points.title: Selection
points.text: We check the produce arriving at our stands to offer each customer the product that best matches their needs.

points.title: Market
points.text: We know how each season unfolds and help our customers anticipate changes in supply.

buyers.title: A partner for volume buyers.
buyers.body: We work with professional buyers who need produce by the case and by the pallet, with continuity and direct contact.

experience.title: Three decades in the fruit and vegetable wholesale trade.
experience.body: Since 1995 we have seen the market, growing regions and buying habits change. What hasn't changed is how we work: knowing the produce, delivering on what we agree and looking after every business relationship.

mercabarna.title: At the heart of Barcelona's food supply.
mercabarna.body: Our stands are in Pavilion E of Mercabarna, one of Europe's major wholesale food markets. This is where we receive produce from our suppliers and where our customers collect it.
mercabarna.pickup: Buyers collect their goods from our stands using their own vehicles, hauliers or hired trucks. International buyers also arrange their own transport from Mercabarna.

producers.quote: Good growers. Good produce. Strong relationships.
producers.body: Close, long-standing relationships with the people who grow and pack at source allow us to select good produce and find opportunities every season. That is the foundation of what we offer our customers.

suppliersInvite.title: Have a great product? Let's talk.
suppliersInvite.body: We are looking for growers, cooperatives and fresh produce companies seeking a wholesale channel at Mercabarna, including in new categories.

contactCta.title: Check what's available this season.
contactCta.body: Tell us what produce you need and we will let you know what we can offer.

hero.title: Knowing the produce and the people who grow it.
hero.lead: We are a fruit and vegetable wholesaler based at Mercabarna. Our strength lies in knowing how to buy, selecting the right produce and connecting good growing regions with professional buyers.

about.title: A Barcelona fresh produce wholesaler.
about.body1: Fruites del Baix Llobregat, S.L. is a wholesale fruit and vegetable business. We buy from growers and suppliers, receive the produce at our stands in Mercabarna and sell it to wholesalers, distributors, supermarkets, grocery chains and international buyers.
about.body2: Our name refers to a place, the Baix Llobregat, an area with a long market-gardening tradition near Barcelona. Today we handle a wide range of Spanish produce that changes with every season and with the opportunities the market offers.

history.title: In the wholesale trade since 1995.
history.body: We have been buying and selling fruit and vegetables for around three decades. This experience lets us read each season, assess produce quickly and respond to what our customers need.

mercabarna.title: Pavilion E, stands 5007, 5037 and 5038.
mercabarna.body: Mercabarna brings together much of Catalonia's wholesale food trade and is a meeting point for buyers from across Spain and abroad. Being there means we deal directly with suppliers and customers every day.

howWeWork.title: From source to buyer, step by step.

steps.title: Buying at source
steps.text: We buy from growers and suppliers we know, mainly in Spain.

steps.title: Arrival at Mercabarna
steps.text: Suppliers deliver the produce to our stands at Mercabarna.

steps.title: Selection
steps.text: We check the produce and guide each customer towards the product that best suits their needs.

steps.title: Sale and collection
steps.text: We sell by the case, by the pallet and in volume. Customers collect their goods at Mercabarna with their own transport.

producers.title: Relationships built season after season.
producers.body: We keep in close contact with quality growers and suppliers. These relationships, built over time, give us access to good produce and help us spot buying opportunities. We also handle some products of our own.

selection.title: The right produce for every customer.
selection.body: Not every buyer needs the same thing. We listen to what each customer is looking for and point them to produce that fits their channel, their end customer and their buying window.

market.title: Reading every season.
market.body: Our range changes with the season, the weather, harvest campaigns and available supply. Following the market closely allows us to adapt and handle different products according to demand.

philosophy.title: Experience, selection and trust, every season.

values.title: Product quality
values.text: Careful selection of fruit and vegetables, backed by market knowledge.

values.title: Close to the source
values.text: Close, long-standing relationships with growers and suppliers.

values.title: Adaptability
values.text: Able to handle different products and seasons as demand changes.

values.title: Trust
values.text: Long-term business relationships built on direct contact and delivering on what we agree.

seasonal.name: Seasonal fruit
seasonal.description: Stone fruit, pome fruit and other fruit that come in and out of our range as the season progresses.

citrus.name: Citrus
citrus.description: Mandarins, oranges and other citrus fruit, especially important in autumn and winter.

melons.name: Melons and watermelons
melons.description: Key lines in spring and summer, in different types depending on the time of season.

vegetables.name: Vegetables
vegetables.description: Aubergines, peppers, courgettes and other Spanish-grown vegetables.

local.name: Local produce
local.description: Produce from the Baix Llobregat and the Barcelona area when the season allows.

specialties.name: Other specialities
specialties.description: Market opportunities and new categories. Ask us about what you are looking for.

artichoke.name: Prat artichoke
artichoke.description: One of our most representative products, closely tied to the Baix Llobregat area. A cool-season classic, highly valued by discerning buyers.

mandarin.name: Mandarin
mandarin.description: A particularly important product in our 2026 season. We work with different growing areas and harvest windows to give our customers continuity.

melon.name: Melon
melon.description: A key line in certain seasons. We choose origin and timing carefully to offer melons that meet end-customer expectations.

eggplant.name: Aubergine
eggplant.description: One of our regular lines. Spanish-grown, with an ongoing presence in our range depending on the season and growing area.

pepper.name: Pepper
pepper.description: Spanish-grown peppers in different types and colours, depending on what is available at the time.

zucchini.name: Courgette
zucchini.description: Another regular vegetable line in our range, sourced from different growing regions across Spain.

sections.title: Terms of use

sections.title: Liability

sections.title: Applicable law

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: {company}. Business premises: Mercabarna, Pavilion E, 08040 Barcelona (Spain). Contact email: {email}.

sections.title: Data we process
sections.body: The details you provide in our contact, buyer and supplier forms: name, company, email, phone (optional), country and any commercial information you choose to include. Please do not include data that is not needed for your enquiry.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: To respond to your enquiry and, where applicable, to manage any resulting business relationship. We do not use your data to send you unsolicited marketing communications.

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.body: Your consent when submitting the form and, where applicable, taking steps at your request prior to entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(a) and 6(1)(b) GDPR).

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep your data for as long as needed to handle your enquiry and thereafter for the periods required by law.

sections.title: Recipients and processors
sections.body: We do not share your data with third parties unless required by law. To run the website and send form submissions we use technology providers (web hosting and email service) acting as data processors with appropriate safeguards.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to {email}. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

sections.title: Security
sections.body: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect data, such as encrypted transmission (HTTPS) and data minimisation. Form messages are not stored in any website database.

sections.title: What cookies are
sections.body: Cookies are small files that a website stores in your browser. Some are needed for the website to work, while others are used, for example, to measure how it is used.

sections.title: Technical cookies
sections.body: We use one technical cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) to remember your chosen language and local storage to remember your cookie preferences. These are necessary and do not require consent.

sections.title: Analytics cookies
sections.body: If Google Analytics is enabled in the future, it will only load after you accept it in the cookie notice. You can change your choice at any time via the “Cookie settings” link in the footer.

sections.title: Third-party content
sections.body: The map on the contact page is loaded from Google Maps only when you click “Load map”. Google may set its own cookies; see its policy at policies.google.com.

sections.title: How to disable them
sections.body: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings.
